slowDown.title: Slow Down
slowDown.text: Lose track of time. Drift off between dunes and pines, and wake to the sound of the Atlantic.

woodenTrails.title: Wooden Trails
woodenTrails.text: Follow the boardwalks through the dunes to wild Atlantic beaches, Esposende’s old town or the banks of the Cávado river.

beachDays.title: Beach
beachDays.text: A short walk through the dunes and you’re on the beach. Stay until the sun goes down; there’s no rush to get back.

roadTrips.title: Day Trips
roadTrips.text: Porto, Braga and Viana do Castelo are all an easy drive away. Historic centres, port wine and Minho cooking, and you’re back in time for sunset.

goldenHour.title: Golden Hour
goldenHour.text: Chill on the terrace and soak up the Atlantic sunset, every single evening.

surfing.title: Surfing
surfing.text: The Atlantic winds here are made for it. Book a surf or kitesurf lesson and catch your first wave, or your best one yet.

poolDays.title: Pool Days
poolDays.text: When the ocean feels too wild, the pool is just steps away. A sun lounger, a good book and nothing else on the agenda.

buggyTours.title: Buggy Tours
buggyTours.text: Off-Road Buggies: Swap the calm for a little adrenaline: guided buggy tours on the trails nearby.

footer.tagline: Nature escape between the Atlantic and the maritime pine forest.

about.title: Where the pine forest meets the ocean
about.p1: Duna Natura is an apartment set between enchanting maritime pine forests, the wild beaches of Portugal's northern coast and the charming seaside town of Esposende. We believe the best rest comes from slowing down to the rhythm of nature.
about.p2: The location is special for its peace and quiet, its light and its connection to the landscape. Wooden boardwalks cross the dunes to the Atlantic, where the sunset closes every evening of your stay.
about.p3: No stress. Just pines, dunes and the ocean, always a short stroll from everything the town has to offer.
